name: Strawberry Mousse
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: ¼ box gelatine or 1¼ tablespoons granulated gelatine
ingredients.originalText: ¼ box gelatine or 1¼ tablespoons granulated gelatine

instructions.text: Wash and hull berries, sprinkle with sugar, and let stand one hour
Mash, and rub through a fine sieve
Add gelatine soaked in cold and dissolved in boiling water
Set in pan of ice-water and stir until it begins to thicken
Fold in whip from cream, put in mould, cover, pack in salt and ice, and let stand four hours

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Wash and hull berries, sprinkle with sugar, and let stand one hour
2. Mash, and rub through a fine sieve
3. Add gelatine soaked in cold and dissolved in boiling water
4. Set in pan of ice-water and stir until it begins to thicken
5. Fold in whip from cream, put in mould, cover, pack in salt and ice, and let stand four hours
originalIngredients: ¼ box gelatine or 1¼ tablespoons granulated gelatine
